Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.
With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.
This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.
What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.
At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.
About the role
The Strategic Project Manager role is Homa's program for exceptional talent. We hire bright, ambitious people from different backgrounds and deploy them where they can have the most impact. You'll work directly with our Chief of Staff, the C-level team, and the leaders of the teams you're deployed to.
You'll own projects end to end, with full ownership and autonomy: framing the problem, finding the solution, and driving real, measurable impact. You won't be a support function. You'll be a strategic contributor.
How it works

• Deployed where it matters most. Based on your strengths and the company's priorities, you'll be embedded in one team or several, on the projects that matter most right now.
• Missions of different lengths. Some projects last three months, others a year. When one ends, you move on to the next challenge.
• A true 360° view. Over time, you'll build a deep understanding of how a fast-moving gaming company works, across strategy, product, growth, finance, people, and AI.
• Growing responsibility. As you prove yourself, your scope grows. Some of our Strategic Project Managers go on to lead teams or take permanent roles in the functions they joined.
Where you could be deployed
Your projects could span any of these areas:

• AI. Work with our dedicated AI unit to design and deploy AI-powered workflows across the company.
• Data & Tech. Partner with data and engineering teams on projects where technology drives business impact.
• BD & Partnerships. Drive external growth that expands Homa's ecosystem.
• Product & Gaming. Shape roadmap priorities, market analysis, and go-to-market strategy for our games.
• Growth & User Acquisition. Work on performance strategy, monetization, and scaling initiatives that drive revenue.
• Creatives & Marketing. Shape how our games win attention, from ad creatives, and to trend-driven campaigns.
• People & Transformation. Partner with HR leadership on talent strategy, team structure, and organizational change.
• Finance. Build financial models, business cases, and strategic plans alongside finance leadership.
What you'll do

• Partner. Act as a trusted partner to leadership, turning business needs into structured plans.
• Analyze. Run market research, competitive benchmarks, and business models that inform executive decisions.
• Transform. Lead cross-functional projects that improve how Homa operates and scales.
• Execute. Take initiatives from design to implementation, aligning teams and delivering measurable outcomes.
• Automate. Use AI to multiply your own impact and your team's.
• Communicate. Build sharp strategic materials and represent leadership in key internal and external forums.
Why Homa

• Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
• Real ownership, early. Your projects will change how Homa operates, and you'll see the results.
• Learn from leadership. You'll work alongside leaders and people who make decisions.
• A high talent bar. Our teams are small and demanding, and the people around you will push you to grow.
• AI at the core. You'll have access to the best AI tools, and you'll help shape how an AI-first company works.
Requirements
Who we're looking for

• A track record of excellence. Strong academic results from a leading school.
• First experience in consulting, finance, tech, gaming, or a fast-paced startup, and achievements beyond your JD.
• Ownership. You drive outcomes; when something breaks, you fix it rather than explain it.
• Initiative. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You see what needs doing, and you do it.
• Pragmatism. You find the simplest solution that works and make decisions with imperfect information.
• Sharp thinking. You break down complex problems, reason from first principles, and turn data into action.
• AI fluency. AI is already how you work. You use it to automate, accelerate, and rethink.
• Hunger. You're ambitious, high-energy, and grounded. You're building a career, not filling a position.
• Adaptability. You thrive when no two months look the same, and you get up to speed fast in unfamiliar territory.
• Clarity. You communicate in a concise, straight-to-the-point way, both in writing and in person.
• A builder's record (a plus). You've shipped a game, an app, a side project, or an initiative of your own.…
